paragraphs: Japita is the weekly purchasing advisor for restaurants. It puts your suppliers, offers, and spending in one place. It recommends what to buy this week, and from which supplier, based on quality, delivered price, and your own preferences. Gemma on AMD reads Japanese specifications, drafts supplier questions, and translates supplier comments. A person approves every message, basket, and order.
Built for the AMD Developer Hackathon ACT III. Tracks: Reinvent Commerce, plus Evolus Business Agents on AMD.
All data is fictional. The restaurant, suppliers, offers, prices, orders, and supplier messages are invented for the demo. No real orders or payments happen.
features: Live app: (API: the free API sleeps when idle, so the first request can take up to a minute)
